Themes organize layouts, templates, sections, blocks, snippets, assets and configuration. Sections
are configurable; snippets are reusable rendering fragments.
Theme එJකේ layout එක page shell එකයි. Template එක page type එක Jතහෝරනවා. Sections සහ
blocks editor එJකන් Jවනස් කළ හුකි Jකාටස්.

A merchant customizes a product hero section without editing its Liquid code.
